items.prompt: Express sin 41° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 49°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 131°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 139°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 41°, because sine and cosine are always equal

tan θ = 5/12
